items.summary: Add a backend function to export all Nakshatra data including text content (name, description, deity, symbol, characteristics, lunarClimate, karmicLesson, and all four pada descriptions) and return it as a serializable data structure
Add a backend function to export all uploaded image blobs with their associated Nakshatra IDs, returning image data and metadata in a format suitable for cross-canister transfer
Add a backend import function that accepts Nakshatra data and replaces all existing Nakshatra entries, ensuring imported data completely overwrites current state
Add a backend import function that accepts image data with IDs and stores all imported images, replacing any existing images with matching IDs
Create a frontend admin utility that automatically fetches all data from the live canister and imports it into the draft canister when triggered, implementing the complete sync workflow
Add a 'Sync from Live' button in the admin panel that triggers the automatic data synchronization from live to draft, displaying sync progress and completion status
Update the AdminPage to display sync status information showing when the last sync occurred and whether draft data is in sync with live data
